Task title: Access control for deleting users
Function entrypoint: delete_user

Product ticket:
# Product ticket: delete user

## Background
Support administrators need to delete active users that should no longer exist in the system.

## Happy path
- Admin deletes an active target user.
- Target status becomes deleted.

## Edge cases
- Missing targets should fail.
- Deleted targets should not be deleted again.

## Acceptance criteria
- Admin delete succeeds.
- Target state is updated.

public_spec:
Title: Access control for deleting users

Behavior requirements:
- delete_user(entrypoint) must require admin authorization prior to performing any destructive user action.
- Only authenticated admins (admin role) may initiate deletion of a target user.
- On successful authorization, delete_user must change target user state from active to deleted.
- Audit log must record admin identity and target user deleted action.

Edge cases:
- If target user does not exist, delete_user should fail with a not-found error and no state change occurs.
- If target user is already in deleted state, delete_user should fail with an already-deleted error and no further action occurs.
- If the requesting user is not an admin, delete_user should fail with an authorization error and no state change occurs.
- If target user deletion would violate invariants (e.g., system-critical accounts), operation should be denied with appropriate error.

Acceptance criteria:
- Admin authorization is verified before any deletion logic executes.
- Target user state changes from active to deleted when an authorized admin deletes a target active user.
- Deleting a non-existent target results in a not-found failure.
- Deleting an already-deleted target results in an error and no state change.
- All delete actions are auditable with admin identity and target user reference.

Non-goals:
- Implementing non-destructive suspension instead of deletion is out of scope.
- Admin self-deletion or deletion of admin accounts is not specified and not allowed unless explicitly covered by policy.

Testable assertions:
- Given an admin user and an active target, delete_user returns success and target state becomes deleted.
- Given a non-admin user, delete_user returns authorization error and target state remains unchanged.
- Given a non-existent target, delete_user returns not-found error.
- Given an already-deleted target, delete_user returns already-deleted error.
